technique_name: Write a report about the advantages of using renewable energy sources.
description: Renewable energy sources such as wind, solar, water and geothermal power have the potential to play a major role in reducing the world's dependence on non-renewable energy sources and combatting the effects of climate change. Using renewable energy sources has many benefits, such as providing clean, emissions-free energy, creating jobs in the renewable energy industry, and reducing energy costs through improved energy efficiency.
